tools.name: gh
tools.description: Run the GitHub CLI (`gh`) in a checkout of the pull request's repository, authenticated as the PR author. Returns stdout, or stderr and the exit code on failure. Supports every gh command, including `gh api` (REST and GraphQL).

args.description: Arguments after `gh`, e.g. `pr view 42 --comments` or `api repos/owner/repo/pulls/42/comments`.
